Category: Very Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 1

Iconic Cyberarm Option. Needs a Shock Absorber and 1 Cyberarm Option Slot. The absorber's Autofire bonus rises by 1 to +2, and a Critical Failure (1) on an Autofire check no longer rolls the implosion d10, though everything else about the Critical Failure still happens.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Change the Shock Absorber's effect to +2 while this is installed.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
